text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn from data. In supervised learning, a model is trained using training data that includes both inputs and correct answers. During training, the model finds patterns in the data and learns how to make predictions. After training, the model can look at new information and give its own answers. The quality of the training data is very important, because better data usually leads to better results. We measure how well a model works by checking its accuracy. The higher the accuracy, the more reliable the predictions are. Machine learning is used in many everyday things, such as search engines and recommendation systems.
